frozenBefore: p00 was read for the first time
purpose: Confirmatory only. p00 is a performer no model in this workstream has ever trained on, evaluated on, or selected against. This measures whether the preservation result established on rehearsed performers p01-p05 also holds on an unseen player.

trigger.condition: a frozen study produced an eligible candidate
trigger.note: Every prior study concluded retain-v1 with zero eligible candidates, so this condition has never been met before.

whatIsMeasured.subject: rehearsal-heavy weights decoded with duration-viterbi
whatIsMeasured.baseline: v1 decoded with its production-parity decoder (uniform-penalty Viterbi, penalty 4.0)
whatIsMeasured.data: GuitarSet performer p00 only, both captures (audio_mono-mic, audio_mono-pickup_mix)
whatIsMeasured.priorsPolicy: Decoder priors for p00 are derived from p01-p05 ONLY. Nothing p00's own references imply may shape the decoder that scores it.
whatIsMeasured.decoderScalars: Unchanged from the frozen decoder study. Nothing is re-tuned for p00.

singleMeasurementPolicy.rule: This is measured ONCE and reported whatever it shows.
singleMeasurementPolicy.noSelection: The result may NOT be used to choose between candidates, decoders, checkpoints or parameters. There is exactly one subject and one baseline, fixed above, and no alternatives are scored.
singleMeasurementPolicy.noRetry: If the outcome is unfavourable it stands. Re-running with a different candidate after seeing p00 would convert the held-out performer into a selection set and destroy the only unbiased measurement this workstream has.
singleMeasurementPolicy.afterThis: p00 is spent. It can no longer serve as a virgin holdout for any later study, and later studies must say so rather than quietly reusing it.

confirmationCriteria.rationale: The same preservation tolerances the gates apply on p01-p05, applied unchanged to p00. Declared before the measurement so the outcome cannot be reinterpreted after the fact.
confirmationCriteria.confirmed: No regression against v1 beyond the frozen preservation tolerances on either capture: root <= 2.0 pp, detailed <= 2.0 pp, fragmentation increase <= 0.015, regions-per-minute increase <= 0.75.
confirmationCriteria.stronglyConfirmed: Additionally improves root AND detailed accuracy on both captures, as it did on p01-p05.
confirmationCriteria.refuted: Any regression beyond those tolerances on either capture. This would mean the p01-p05 gains were substantially a rehearsal effect that does not generalise to an unseen player, and it would be recorded as the headline finding.
confirmationCriteria.interpretationLimit: p00 is a single performer, solo acoustic guitar. Confirmation here bounds performer-level generalisation within GuitarSet; it says nothing about full-band production audio, which remains untested against a real-recorded benchmark.

doesNotChange: No application default or release gating changes.
No model is exported or shipped by this measurement.
The Slakh test split remains untouched.
